The free indirect passages generalize a great deal (marriage, women, dreams) but do so in past tense/past-modal, so they are event/past per the present-only gnomic rule rather than gnomic. Quotation marks survive in only 2 of 10 dialogue quotes; the rest were identified by vocative, second-person address, imperative, or first-person voice inside a third-person narrative. 10 event quotes, 10/10 past.
